claims.claim: The week leading to October 30 had approximately $4.3M net XRP ETF inflows; October 29 was about +$8.4M and October 26 about -$3.6M.

accounting_rules: Cumulative net flows are a flow measure, not a point-in-time asset balance.
ETF net assets are a mark-to-market stock, not cumulative subscriptions.
Underlying XRP units held, creations, redemptions, fees, cash balances and derivative hedges must be separate features.
Positive ETF flows do not imply the net marginal buyer dominates all other spot, OTC, distribution and derivative-related selling.
Do not convert reported net flows into a direct buy-pressure feature until source methodology and timing are documented.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: ETF net buying was positive but too small to offset broader spot distribution and macro risk-off selling.
ETF creations absorbed some supply and may have reduced downside relative to a no-ETF counterfactual, even while absolute price declined.
AUM decline primarily reflects mark-to-market losses rather than investor redemptions.
ETF flows are lagged or confounded by broader market returns, leverage, market-maker hedging, treasury distributions and OTC flows.
The exact phrase 'ASK Coin' refers to Permission Coin's ASK token.
Permission ASK is directly integrated with XRP/XRPL.

model_requirements: Use daily and intraday ETF creations/redemptions, shares outstanding, XRP units held, custody addresses where disclosed, and net asset value separately.
Align ETF flow timestamps to exchange spot, futures OI/funding, liquidation, order-book depth and macro events.
Test contemporaneous, lagged and lead relationships without look-ahead; include BTC/ETH/XLM and broad risk proxies as controls.
Evaluate whether flows predict returns beyond price momentum, volatility, funding, OI, dollar strength, rates and supply/distribution variables.
Keep ASK candidate identity separate from XRP token graph until an official integration announcement or verified on-chain path exists.
